symbols.summary: Reads a single version condition from an If-Match header or request body.

syntax.content: public static Result ReadCondition(string header, string bodyETag = null)

parameters.description: An optional raw version or transport tag supplied in the body.

returns.description: The decoded version or the raw version with surrounding whitespace trimmed. When both inputs are omitted or blank, the successful value is null. Malformed transport tags, unsupported conditions, and conflicting values return a BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.ValidationError.

symbols.name: Write(HttpResponse, string)
symbols.summary: Sets a single strong ETag with the quoted bdk. Base64Url transport format.
symbols.remarks: Exact round-trips through BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.OpaqueVersionETag.ReadCondition(System.String%2cSystem.String) require a nonblank, well-formed UTF-16 version free of control characters. A version that becomes * when its surrounding double quotes are trimmed is treated as a wildcard. UTF-8 encoding replaces unpaired surrogates.
